results.user: I'm all stirred up after a fight with my daughter. Shaky, tight stomach. Maybe a 7 out of 10.
results.visibleReply:
That sounds raw. A fight with your daughter, and your body is already telling you about it — shaky, stomach tight, 7 out of 10.

Let's start with the body, since it's already talking.

Can you put one hand on your stomach — just rest it there gently. Feel the tightness under your palm.

Take a slow breath in, and let the out-breath go a little longer than the in. Don't force it. Just let the exhale find its own end.

Do that once or twice, and then tell me: does the tightness shift at all, even slightly?

Stay with your hand on your stomach for a moment. Not to fix it — just to feel it.

What happened with your daughter?

results.user: No — it really didn't help. I feel exactly the same.
results.visibleReply:
Got it. We'll leave the breath alone.

Try this instead — press your feet into the floor. Really press, like you're trying to feel the ground through your shoes. Hold it for a few seconds, then release. Do that twice.

Then — make a slow fist with each hand, one at a time. Spread the fingers wide on the way out. Three times, slowly.

Just those two things. Tell me what you notice.
